name: @sparq-org/solid-server
description: Local-development Solid/LDP server backed by sparq WebAssembly.

scripts._copy:wasm: rm -rf wasm && mkdir wasm && cp ../../crates/sparq-lws-wasm/pkg/sparq_lws_wasm.js ../../crates/sparq-lws-wasm/pkg/sparq_lws_wasm.d.ts ../../crates/sparq-lws-wasm/pkg/sparq_lws_wasm_bg.wasm ../../crates/sparq-lws-wasm/pkg/sparq_lws_wasm_bg.wasm.d.ts wasm/
scripts.build:lws-wasm: wasm-pack build ../../crates/sparq-lws-wasm --target web --profile release-wasm --features sparql-endpoint --config profile.release-wasm.strip=false && npm run _copy:wasm
scripts.build:lws-wasm-core: wasm-pack build ../../crates/sparq-lws-wasm --target web --profile release-wasm --config profile.release-wasm.strip=false && npm run _copy:wasm
scripts.prepack: npm run build:lws-wasm && npm run check:package
